## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-*juan* late-Míng / early-Qīng Lotus Sūtra commentary by the lay Buddhist scholar [徐昌治](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%90%E6%98%8C%E6%B2%BB) Xú Chāngzhì (sobriquet **Wúyī dàorén** 無依道人, "Master Without-Refuge"). The work is preserved as X32n0617 in the *Xùzàngjīng* and represents the early-Qīng continuation of the late-Wànlì literati-Buddhist commentarial tradition.

**Abstract**

Xú Chāngzhì's *Zhuójiě* belongs to the early-Qīng continuation of the late-Wànlì literati-Buddhist commentarial tradition, parallel to [焦竑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A6%E7%AB%91) Jiāo Hóng's *Pínglín* ([KR6d0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0078)) and the broader late-Míng tradition of distinctive personal commentaries on the Lotus Sūtra. The work's seven-*juan* extent and continuous-running structure place it among the more substantial late-imperial Lotus commentaries.

The dating is bracketed within the early-Qīng productive period c. 1644–1700.
